revision_summary: Three quotes in script_coverage carry wrong timestamps (all minor, words exist elsewhere in transcript, not fabricated content): (1) interest_question customer_quote is attributed to 00:27 but actually starts at 00:38 (00:27 is the rep still confirming the address) — fix ts to 00:38. (2) appointment_set customer_quote 'So 12PM noon on, Friday, the seventh' is attributed to the customer at 03:32, but this line is actually spoken by the REP at 05:52 — this is a speaker attribution error, not just a timing error, and should be corrected to reflect the rep said it, with the actual customer confirmation ('K.' at 05:54) used instead if a customer quote is needed. (3) button_up customer_quote 'Alright. Sounds good. Thank you' is attributed to 05:54 but that ts is the rep speaking; the customer's actual sign-off appears at the very end of the call (~06:24) merged into the closing exchange — fix ts to ~06:24. On revision, also: (a) reconcile the cross_sell_miss classification for the Powerwall moment (cherry_pick_moments[4]) — the label contradicts Stage 3's own accepted alternative_hypothesis that scope discipline was correct; relabel as a scope-discipline-correct moment rather than a miss, or make the classification and verdict consistent. (b) Rename script_coverage section id 'tax_credit_qualifier' to 'credit_qualifier' since the content is entirely about the credit score threshold, not the tax credit disclosure. (c) Soften certainty in the spouse-handling coaching_focus item — the schema's spouse_decision protocol is triggered by explicit spousal-decision-maker language, and this call only surfaced a title-ownership disclosure; frame as a related-but-adjacent gap rather than asserting it is definitively the canonical protocol violation. (d) Nuance interest_reason_audit's 'reason_used: no' — the rep did partially call back to the Tesla/EV detail at 03:13 when asking about home charging, which is a partial operational reference even if never used persuasively; reflect this partial credit rather than a flat no. These are all minor-to-moderate targeted fixes; the core trajectory read, bill-anchor-missed-flip finding, and booked outcome are well-grounded and should be retained.
